channel.title: Wildcard Watch: Fortinet
channel.description: Exploited vulnerabilities and attacks involving Fortinet, each with its fix status and first step.

item.title: Patch now: Fortinet Releases Critical Security Hardening Updates for Multiple Products
item.description:
Fortinet (multiple products): CCB warning · fix available · CCB: patch immediately

First step: Install the security update for the affected Fortinet products. The CCB advisory lists the affected and fixed versions.

The Centre for Cybersecurity Belgium (CCB) warns about this and advises to patch immediately. The CCB advisory lists the affected versions and the fix.

Critical · Fix available

item.title: Patch: Fortinet (multiple products): Path Traversal
item.description:
Fortinet (multiple products): Path traversal (file read/write) · admin required · local access · exploited · fix: 7.4.10, 7.6.5, 1.7.1

First step: Update the affected Fortinet products to the fixed version for your release line (for example 7.4.10, 7.6.5 or 1.7.1).

FortiOS, FortiPAM, FortiProxy, and FortiSwitchManager contain a path traversal vulnerability that may allow an authenticated attacker with admin profile and at least read-write permissions to write or delete arbitrary files via specific CLI commands.

Medium · Fix available · CVE-2025-61624

item.title: Patch: Fortinet FortiMail: Path Traversal
item.description:
Fortinet FortiMail: Path traversal (file read/write) · pre-auth · internet-facing · exploited from day 0 · fix available

First step: Install the security update for Fortinet FortiMail from the vendor advisory.

Fortinet FortiMail contains a path traversal and an improper neutralization of NULL byte or NULL character vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying system via crafted HTTP or HTTPS requests.

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-104286
